question: What supreme śakti abides above the Śiva principle and what is her role?
premises: Above the Śiva principle is the supreme śakti.
She abides as the agent of all causes.
inference: Samanā is the supreme causal agency operating above the Śiva principle.
plain_english: Above the Śiva principle is the supreme śakti called Samanā. She abides as the active agent of all causes.
